# Shajin KP

> Shajin KP is a Product Engineer from Kerala, India, building products for the internet around AI: 2x national hackathon winner (including 1st prize at the Conqueror national-level hackathon, IHRD Tharang, Feb 2023), founder of DesignLumo (acquired), and currently at Latelogic.

## Projects

- [SendThis](https://sendthis.com): A Latelogic product that Shajin leads and built end to end. Send large files with a link. Share and track file transfers on web and iOS, with no ads on either end.
- [Parceler](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/parceler-parcel-tracking-app/id6772164367): A Latelogic iOS parcel-tracking app that Shajin started and built with the team. Add a tracking number or scan a barcode to follow deliveries across hundreds of carriers.
- [LargeFileTransfer](https://largefiletransfer.com): A company product Shajin worked on and helped scale. Send big files fast and securely. Drop a file, share a link.
- [DesignLumo](https://shajinkp.com/designlumo/) ([site](https://designlumo.com)): Shajin's own startup, built solo from scratch. An AI design tool for editable, on-brand visuals for ads, social posts and posters. Bootstrapped and acquired.
- [Isselo](https://isselo.com): A company product Shajin led as PM and helped scale with a small team. Restaurant SaaS that works on any platform.

## Writing

- [Winning two national hackathons solo, against teams of college students](https://shajinkp.com/writing/two-national-hackathons/): Shajin's two national-level hackathon wins, including 1st prize at Conqueror (IHRD Tharang, Feb 2023), as the only individual participant.

- [How I bootstrapped DesignLumo to an exit, part-time with $0 on ads](https://shajinkp.com/writing/bootstrapping-designlumo/): Building a truly editable AI design tool solo from August 2025, growing it to about $400 MRR via Product Hunt, Reddit and SEO, and selling it.
